name: makoma-site
description: M'AKOMA marketing site. The site itself is dependency-free static HTML/CSS/JS — this file exists ONLY so Vercel installs the one package api/design-upload.js needs. Speed Insights and Web Analytics are script tags in index.html, not npm packages, because there is no bundler here. Deliberately has NO build script: adding one would make Vercel try to build the static site instead of serving it as-is.
